name: Scenario Design for Managing Uncertainty
description: Defining a problem; risk and uncertainty; levels of uncertainty, commonly employed approaches to manage uncertainty; definition of a scenario; methods of constructing scenarios; the advantages of scenario analysis; examples of energy and climate scenarios; adaptive decision making; application across different domains.
